params.body:
## What

Each row in the Netwerk list had a text button: "Projecten" on a relation, "Wie" on a project, "Sluiten" once open. Under an opened contact every project row ended in "Wie", which reads as a question rather than a control, and the words changed per row.

The button is now a fold-out arrow, the same on every row: pointing right when closed, down when open. Its tooltip and screen-reader label say what it opens ("Projecten van deze relatie tonen", "Relaties op dit project tonen", "Dichtklappen"), and it carries aria-expanded.

The same wording goes into the panel heading ("Relaties op dit project" instead of "Wie erop stond"), the empty-state hint and the graph's hover hint.

## Checks

- 345 PHP tests, 19 JS tests and pint pass.
- Checked on a demo copy with a relation folded open.
